name: Andres Arizmendi
title: AI Developer
description: I'm an AI developer specializing in generative AI and large language model systems. I design and build end-to-end AI products — from research prototypes to production services — with FastAPI backends, React frontends and modern machine learning tooling.

Most of my work sits where retrieval, agents and multimodal models meet real products: reverse image search on neural embeddings, node-graph agent orchestration, unified LLM provider wrappers and fine-tuned vision-language models. I also build for the other side of the browser — WebGL renderers, canvas games and developer tools.
